segments.snp4.10:1.3: Taṃ me gotama pabrūhi, pucchito uttamaṃ naraṃ”.
segments.snp4.10:3.3: Mantabhāṇī [mantābhāṇī (syā. pī.)] anuddhato, sa ve vācāyato muni.
segments.snp4.10:4.3: Vivekadassī phassesu, diṭṭhīsu ca na nīyati [niyyati (bahūsu)].
segments.snp4.10:5.3: Appagabbho ajeguccho, pesuṇeyye ca no yuto.
segments.snp4.10:6.3: Saṇho ca paṭibhānavā [paṭibhāṇavā (syā. pī.)], na saddho na virajjati.
segments.snp4.10:7.1: “Lābhakamyā na sikkhati, alābhe ca na kuppati;
segments.snp4.10:8.1: “Upekkhako sadā sato, na loke maññate samaṃ;
segments.snp4.10:8.3: Na visesī na nīceyyo, tassa no santi ussadā.
segments.snp4.10:9.1: “Yassa nissayanā [nissayatā (sī. syā. pī.)] natthi, ñatvā dhammaṃ anissito;
segments.snp4.10:9.3: Bhavāya vibhavāya vā, taṇhā yassa na vijjati.
segments.snp4.10:10.3: Ganthā tassa na vijjanti, atarī so visattikaṃ.
segments.snp4.10:11.1: “Na tassa puttā pasavo, khettaṃ vatthuñca vijjati;
segments.snp4.10:11.3: Attā vāpi nirattā vā [attaṃ vāpi nirattaṃ vā (bahūsu)], na tasmiṃ upalabbhati.
segments.snp4.10:12.3: Taṃ tassa apurakkhataṃ, tasmā vādesu nejati.
segments.snp4.10:13.3: Na samesu na omesu, kappaṃ neti akappiyo.
segments.snp4.10:14.1: “Yassa loke sakaṃ natthi, asatā ca na socati;
segments.snp4.10:14.3: Dhammesu ca na gacchati, sa ve santoti vuccatī”ti.
